title.en: The One With the Restaurant Plan

description.es: Marta le dice a Fina que ha organizado un plan para ir a un restaurante esa noche. Fina dice que no puede, porque tiene planes con sus amigos. Marta dice que ese era el único rato libre que ha podido organizar y propone que vayan a pesar de los planes. Fina dice que si siempre va a tener que vivir según el horario de Marta, y discuten.
description.en: Marta tells Fina that she has planned for them to go to a restaurant that evening. Fina says she cannot, because she has plans with her friends. Marta says that this was the only free time she could arrange and suggests they go despite the plans. Fina says, is she always going to have to live according to Marta's schedule, and they argue.
